title: Dockerised Web App
headline: From push to production.
body: A containerized Node.js/Express app with an Azure DevOps pipeline that tests the code, publishes versioned Docker Hub images, and triggers deployment on Render.
subtitle: Delivery workflow
bullets: The YAML pipeline runs automated tests before building and publishing the image.
A multi-stage Dockerfile uses a non-root runtime user and a /health check.
Build-ID and latest tags are pushed through a Docker Hub service connection.
A secret Render deploy-hook variable connects the final deployment stage.

title: Personal Agent · Corrupter
headline: A local brain. A human in control.
body: A personal assistant pairing an Ollama language model with a FastAPI dashboard, browser voice input/output, SQLite conversation history, and a draft–confirm–send email workflow.
subtitle: What is implemented
bullets: Local model chat through Ollama, with a browser-based dashboard and personality editor.
Browser speech recognition and synthesis provide voice input and output; voice is not fully offline.
SQLite stores conversations, statistics and pending actions.
Gmail email drafts require explicit confirmation before sending.
Twilio calls, offline speech and retrieval-based long-term memory are future work.

title: Lenovo LOQ Experience
headline: Performance, frame by frame.
body: A cinematic product showcase built with Next.js and TypeScript. A scroll-linked canvas sequences 240 frames while animated overlays introduce the laptop, performance, and thermal story.
subtitle: Interaction design
bullets: A sticky canvas sequences 240 frames across a 600vh scrolling section.
Framer Motion maps scroll progress to overlay opacity, position and scale.
Product specification cards complete the experience after the sequence.
An independent frontend concept, not an official Lenovo website or purchasing flow.

title: Docker E-Commerce
headline: Storefront to service.
body: A course-based e-commerce application exploring authentication, products, carts, coupons, Stripe checkout, and an admin dashboard, with a Dockerized Node.js backend.
subtitle: Application & container work
bullets: The application includes JWT access/refresh authentication, product and category management, cart and coupon flows.
MongoDB stores application data; Redis supports caching and token-related workflows.
Stripe integration supports checkout, with Cloudinary used for media.
The backend Dockerfile uses Node 24, installs production dependencies and runs as the node user.
The repository credits a course tutorial; presented here as a learning and containerization project.
